entities.summary: Ramsey is a coastal town in the north of the Isle of Man. It is the island's largest town after Douglas was granted city status in 2024. Ramsey's population is 8,288 according to the 2021 Census. It has one of the biggest harbours on the Island, and has a prominent semi-derelict pier, called the Queen's Pier. It was formerly one of the main points of communication with Scotland. Ramsey has also been a route for several invasions by the Vikings and Scots.
